productIssue: Phone clock 70 s or more fast (or a day ahead): the physician taps Dictate in the Hospital or Nursing Home pre-round editor, sees 'Listening…', and after one silent retry gets the red banner 'Live dictation couldn’t start. Check microphone access and your connection, then try again.' with an empty box — every take, nothing transcribed. Separately, a phone a day fast opens the app on the sign-in screen instead of the patient list (see the 'opens signed in' cells). Both break UAT 3.8 (a phone with a wrong clock shows the same state as any other device).
